roadmap.title: Raft basics
roadmap.description: Build your first foundations, craft the grill and purifier, hook items and survive the first day.

roadmap.title: Early islands and survival
roadmap.description: Discover the large island, farm and trade, and start hunting wildlife.

roadmap.title: Mid story
roadmap.description: Explore the Radio Tower, Vasagatan, Balboa and Caravan Town and collect their notes.

roadmap.title: Late story
roadmap.description: Reach Temperance, Varuna Point and Tangaroa, and finish the story.

roadmap.title: Late collections
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining collections, hidden items and character unlocks.

roadmap.title: Long grinds
roadmap.description: Complete the 50-kill hunter tiers, large building counters and 365 days of survival.

steps.text: Build 10 foundations in total with the @item{Building Hammer}.

achievements.description: Team up with a friend in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Play with a friend in the same multiplayer world.

steps.text: Start a world that allows friends to join.
Have your friend join your world.

achievements.description: Craft and place a simple grill.
achievements.summary: Craft a Simple Grill and place it on your raft.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Simple Grill} and place it on your raft.
steps.note: If a friend placed one, remove yours and place it again.

achievements.description: Craft and place a simple purifier.
achievements.summary: Craft a Simple Purifier and place it on your raft.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Simple Purifier} and place it on your raft.
steps.note: If a friend placed one, remove yours and place it again.

achievements.description: Place a sail and a stationary anchor on the same raft.
achievements.summary: Put a sail and a stationary anchor together on a single raft.

steps.text: Place a @item{Sail} on your raft.
steps.note: If a friend placed either, remove both and place them again.

steps.text: Add a @item{Stationary Anchor} to that raft too.

achievements.description: Have 20 storages on the same raft.

steps.text: Place 20 storage containers of any type on one raft.

achievements.description: Have 20 cropplots on the same raft.
achievements.summary: Have 20 crop plots on the same raft.

steps.text: Craft and place 20 crop plots on one raft.

achievements.description: Research everything in the research table.
achievements.summary: Research everything in the research table.

steps.text: Build a @item{Research Table} on your raft.
Research each item it lists until nothing is left to research.
Build 100 foundations in total with the @item{Building Hammer}.
Build 1000 foundations in total with the @item{Building Hammer}.
Wait for a @enemy{Shark} to attack the raft.
Kill one @enemy{Shark}.
Wait for a @enemy{Shark} to attack the raft.
Kill 10 @enemy{Sharks} in total.
Wait for a @enemy{Shark} to attack the raft.
Kill 50 @enemy{Sharks} in total.
Pull 100 floating items out of the water with the hook in total.
Pull 500 floating items out of the water with the hook in total.
Pull 5000 floating items out of the water with the hook in total.
Throw a large stack of items into the sea and hook them back in to save time.
Find @enemy{Seagulls} near your raft.
Kill one @enemy{Seagull}.
Find @enemy{Seagulls} near your raft.
Kill 10 @enemy{Seagulls} in total.
Find @enemy{Seagulls} near your raft.
Kill 50 @enemy{Seagulls} in total.
Paint 50 blocks in total with the @item{Paint Brush}.
Paint 200 blocks in total with the @item{Paint Brush}.
Paint 1000 blocks in total with the @item{Paint Brush}.
Aim at a placed object, remove it, place it again, and repeat until the achievement unlocks.
steps.note: Chopping structures apart with an axe counts as well.

steps.text: Start a game that is not Creative or Hard Mode. Normal Mode is best.
Jump into the water and drown, then respawn.
Repeat until you have died 25 times.

achievements.description: Find the white board at the top of the Radio Tower.
achievements.summary: Reach the highest room of the Radio Tower, where the white board hangs.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Receiver}, a @item{Battery} and 3 @item{Antennas}. Set the antennas on high floors with space between them, load the battery and switch the receiver on.
Enter the 4-number coordinates from the note into the receiver. Sail toward the blue square.
Anchor beside the @loc{Radio Tower} and climb to the top room with the white board.

achievements.summary: Dive to 100 meters below the water surface.

steps.text: Bring @item{Flippers} and an @item{Oxygen Bottle}.
Swim straight down until you reach 100 meters, then return to the surface.
steps.note: Dive beside an island so you can find your way back.

steps.text: Stay alive for one full day. Craft a Calendar to see the day count.
Stay alive for 7 days. Use a Calendar to track them and a bed to skip nights.
Stay alive for 30 days. Use a Calendar to track them and a bed to skip nights.
Stay alive for 365 days. Use a Calendar to track them and a bed to skip nights.
steps.note: Days keep counting if you leave the game open with a dead character.

steps.text: Find Poison-puffers in the water next to large tropical islands.
Kill one @enemy{Poison-puffer}.
Find Poison-puffers in the water next to large tropical islands.
Kill 10 @enemy{Poison-puffers} in total.
Find Poison-puffers in the water next to large tropical islands.
Kill 50 @enemy{Poison-puffers} in total.
Find Screechers on large tropical islands or in @loc{Caravan Town}.
Kill one @enemy{Screecher}.
Find Screechers on large tropical islands or in @loc{Caravan Town}.
Kill 10 @enemy{Screechers} in total.
Find Screechers on large tropical islands or in @loc{Caravan Town}.
Kill 50 @enemy{Screechers} in total.

achievements.summary: Climb the crashed airplane on Pilot Island, a small rare island.

steps.text: Sail with the current until you find a small island with large-island plants and a plane on it.
Climb up to the plane.
steps.note: This island is rare and may take a while to appear.

steps.text: Craft and switch on a @item{Receiver} with its antennas.
Sail toward the green dot on the radar and step onto the island.

achievements.description: Cook a meal by following a recipe.
achievements.summary: Cook a meal in a Cooking Pot by following a recipe.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Cooking Pot} and place it on your raft.
Cook a recipe in it, such as 4 Potatoes or 4 Beets.
Shoot peaceful animals on a large island with a @item{Net Launcher}.
Capture one animal.
Shoot peaceful animals on a large island with a @item{Net Launcher}.
Capture 10 animals in total.
Shoot peaceful animals on a large island with a @item{Net Launcher}.
Capture 50 animals in total.

achievements.summary: Capture an animal with a rare skin using a net.

steps.text: Go to large islands. Each has two or three animals you can tame.
Touch animals with the net until one has a rare skin. Each type has two rare skins.
If none shows up, visit another large island.
Find Warthogs on large tropical islands.
Kill one @enemy{Warthog}.
Find Warthogs on large tropical islands.
Kill 10 @enemy{Warthogs} in total.
Find Warthogs on large tropical islands.
Kill 50 @enemy{Warthogs} in total.

achievements.summary: Reach Captain's Island, the rare tiny island holding a flag and a wrecked boat.

steps.text: Drift with the current until you spot a tiny island that has a flag and a wreck beside it.
Board the shipwreck.
steps.note: This island is rare and may take a while to appear.

achievements.summary: Kill Mama Bear on Balboa Island.

steps.text: Bring a bow with about 50 metal arrows. Stone arrows (75) or thrown stones (147) also work.
Find @enemy{Mama Bear}, the huge sleeping bear in front of the cave at the island centre.
Hit her until she dies.
steps.note: She takes a very large number of hits.

achievements.description: Ring the bicycle bell on Balboa Island.
achievements.summary: Ring the bell on the bicycle on Balboa Island.

steps.text: Follow the signs for Radio 2 until you see the small tent labelled @loc{Henry's Stuff}.
Climb the hill that faces the tent. Follow the ringing sounds to the bicycle.
Interact with the bicycle to ring its bell.

achievements.summary: Give the lightbulb to the dummy in the Ranger Station on Balboa Island.

steps.text: Take the lightbulb from a scarecrow in the hill camp, as in the Tiny Little Murderer achievement.
Carry it to the @loc{Ranger Station} beside Relay Station 2 and give it to the dummy by the door.

achievements.description: Hang all of Bruno's tools on the tool board.
achievements.summary: Hang Bruno's Saw, Wrench and Hammer on the tool board in the Ranger Station on Balboa Island.

steps.text: Put at least 5 @item{Wild Berries} in the basket near @enemy{Mama Bear}'s cave, then take the @item{Machete} from the crate inside the cave.
Find @item{Bruno's Saw} in the locker marked "shh, bear stash !" on the hill to your left on the way to Relay Stations 6 and 4.
Cut the vines on the tunnel to @loc{Relay Station 6} with the Machete. Take @item{Bruno's Wrench} from the counter on the left inside.
Shoot the lever beside the raised bridge to @loc{Relay Station 4} with an arrow or stone. Take @item{Bruno's Hammer} from the shelf next to the big screen.
Bring the three tools to the board inside the @loc{Ranger Station}, close to Relay Station 2, and hang each one.

achievements.description: Take the lightbulb from a scarecrow.
achievements.summary: Take the lightbulb from a scarecrow in the hill camp on Balboa Island.

steps.text: With @enemy{Mama Bear}'s cave in front of you, walk left, then find a trail that climbs a hill; two notes lie on it.
Climb to the camp and interact with a scarecrow.

achievements.description: Find all notes on the Radio Tower!
achievements.summary: Find all 5 notes in the Radio Tower.

collectibles.name: Suitcase note
collectibles.location: Underwater next to the door of building A-2
collectibles.method: Dive down and open the suitcase.

collectibles.name: Building B-1 note
collectibles.location: Lowest floor, in building B-1
collectibles.method: Look left of the red telephone.

collectibles.name: Building C-1 note
collectibles.location: Next floor up, in building C-1
collectibles.method: On the left wall as you enter; the note says TRACE.

collectibles.name: Building D-1 note
collectibles.location: Second to last floor, in building D-1
collectibles.method: Straight ahead as you enter; a post-it.

collectibles.name: White board note
collectibles.location: Top floor, on the white board
collectibles.method: Take the post-it with the coordinates.

collectibles.name: Engine room note
collectibles.location: @loc{Engine room}
collectibles.method: Take it from the table.

collectibles.name: Kitchen note
collectibles.location: @loc{Kitchen}
collectibles.method: Take it from the counter.

collectibles.name: Workshop note
collectibles.location: @loc{Workshop}, last room of the corridor
collectibles.method: Take it from the table.

collectibles.name: Staff room note
collectibles.location: @loc{Staff room}, first room of the corridor
collectibles.method: Use the bolt cutter (taken from the last room down the hold) on the locked locker.

collectibles.name: Dance Hall note
collectibles.location: @loc{Dance Hall}
collectibles.method: Take it next to the bullet.

collectibles.name: Cabin 2 note
collectibles.location: Cabin 2 (big 2 by the door)
collectibles.method: Take it from the desk.

collectibles.name: Cabin 3 note
collectibles.location: Cabin 3 (big 3 by the door)
collectibles.method: Unlock the chest with the code you found in the 2nd floor dining room.

collectibles.name: Dining room note
collectibles.location: @loc{Dining Room}
collectibles.method: Take it from the table where the code lies.

collectibles.name: Fridge room note
collectibles.location: Room blocked by a fridge
collectibles.method: Craft the Car Jack in the hold from 5 mechanical parts and move the fridge.

collectibles.name: Bed note
collectibles.location: Room behind the huge bookshelf, opened with the Green Key
collectibles.method: Take it from the bed beside the lighter.

collectibles.name: Steering wheel note
collectibles.location: Last room, behind the locked door
collectibles.method: Blow the door open with the bomb and take it from the steering wheel.

achievements.summary: Find all 13 notes on Balboa Island.

collectibles.name: Tunnel note
collectibles.location: End of the vine-blocked tunnel
collectibles.method: Clear the vines with the Machete and take it at the far end.

collectibles.name: Stairs note
collectibles.location: Stairs leading up to Relay Station 6
collectibles.method: Take it from the stairs.

collectibles.name: Wall note
collectibles.location: Inside Relay Station 4, on the left
collectibles.method: Take it from the wall next to the blueprint.

collectibles.name: Stool note
collectibles.location: Inside Relay Station 4
collectibles.method: Take it from the stool between the bookcase and the desk.

collectibles.name: Path note 1
collectibles.location: Path up the hill
collectibles.method: Take it from the path.

collectibles.name: Path note 2
collectibles.location: Path up the hill
collectibles.method: Take it from the path.

collectibles.name: Stump note
collectibles.location: Top of the hill
collectibles.method: Take it from the tree stump on the ground.

collectibles.name: Mannequin note
collectibles.location: Top of the hill
collectibles.method: Take it from inside a mannequin.

collectibles.name: Hanged mannequin note
collectibles.location: Top of the hill
collectibles.method: Take it from the hanged mannequin.

collectibles.name: Toolboard note
collectibles.location: Behind the tool board
collectibles.method: Hang Bruno's Saw, Wrench and Hammer on the board to reveal it.

collectibles.name: Mattress note
collectibles.location: Small dark room at the back
collectibles.method: Take it from the mattress.

collectibles.name: Locker note
collectibles.location: Inside Relay Station 2
collectibles.method: Take it from the open locker beside the desk.

collectibles.name: Coordinates note
collectibles.location: Appears after the third lever
collectibles.method: Switch on the lever in each of Relay Stations 2, 4 and 6; the last one gives this note.

achievements.description: Breach the top door of Vasagatan.
achievements.summary: Blow open the locked door at the top of Vasagatan with a bomb.

steps.text: Get the Four Digit Code from a table in the 2nd Floor Dining Room, then open the locked chest in Cabin 3 (1st Floor) for the Electrical Wires. For the Lighter on the 4th Floor bed, first take the Key Card from the 3rd Floor Stage and use it on the first corridor door on the 2nd Floor (Library) to get the Green Key, which opens the 4th Floor door. Also take a Gas Tank from the hold kitchen counter and a Bullet from the Dance Hall bar.
Craft the @item{Bomb} at the tables in the hold.
Place it at the locked door on the top floor and stay down the stairs to avoid the blast.
Find Lurkers on @loc{Vasagatan} or @loc{Tangaroa}.
Kill one @enemy{Lurker}.
Find Lurkers on @loc{Vasagatan} or @loc{Tangaroa}.
Kill 10 @enemy{Lurkers} in total.

guide.context: Lurkers on @loc{Vasagatan} respawn quickly, so you can kill them again in the same spot.

steps.text: Find Lurkers on @loc{Vasagatan} or @loc{Tangaroa}.
Kill 50 @enemy{Lurkers} in total.
Find Bears on @loc{Balboa Island}.
Kill one @enemy{Bear}.
Find Bears on @loc{Balboa Island}.
Kill 10 @enemy{Bears} in total.

guide.context: Bears on @loc{Balboa Island} respawn a few minutes after dying, so you can kill them again in the same spot.

steps.text: Find Bears on @loc{Balboa Island}.
Kill 50 @enemy{Bears} in total.

achievements.description: Find and hang all developer paintings.
achievements.summary: Dig up all 8 developer paintings and hang them on your raft.

steps.text: Get the @item{Metal Detector} blueprint underwater at Caravan Town by following the pipe connected to the bike next to the Tower, then craft it.
On islands, follow the Metal Detector lights until all are on, then dig with a Shovel.
Open suitcases and safes you dig up. Each can hold paintings, and safes can hold two.
Save before digging. If a suitcase lacks a painting you need, reload and dig it again.
Hang all 8 on your raft. The set is Real Self Portrait, Octohenge, Man and Moon, Foul Fogs, The Pot, Neighbors Dog, What Even Is? and After The Rain.

achievements.description: Find all notes on Caravan Town!
achievements.summary: Find all 10 notes in Caravan Town.

collectibles.name: Left side note
collectibles.location: Left side of the town as seen from the port
collectibles.method: Walk up from the port and take it.

collectibles.name: Water pump note
collectibles.location: Top of the town, next to the water pump
collectibles.method: Take it beside the pump.

collectibles.name: Caravan roof note
collectibles.location: Just above the top of the town, on the right
collectibles.method: Climb the caravan to reach it.

collectibles.name: Canned goods caravan note
collectibles.location: Caravan with the CANNED GOODS sign in the circle of caravans
collectibles.method: Go inside and take it.

collectibles.name: Tower top note
collectibles.location: Top of the tower
collectibles.method: Climb the tower.

collectibles.name: Rocket island note
collectibles.location: Island next to the rocket, reached through the tower without a zipline
collectibles.method: Take it next to the rocket.

collectibles.name: Bicycle note
collectibles.location: Base of the tower, beside a bicycle
collectibles.method: Take it beside the bicycle.

collectibles.name: Ladder caravan note
collectibles.location: Caravan next to a ladder, near the wooden bridge from the tower to the rocket island
collectibles.method: Take it from the caravan.

collectibles.name: Infirmary note
collectibles.location: Infirmary, in a building reached only by zipline from the tower
collectibles.method: Use the zipline and take it inside; the safe key is here too.

collectibles.name: Mayor's safe note
collectibles.location: Mayor's safe
collectibles.method: Open the safe with the key from the Infirmary.

collectibles.name: Cafeteria note
collectibles.location: Cafeteria
collectibles.method: Take it from the counter.

collectibles.name: Sliding puzzle note
collectibles.location: Room after the container puzzle
collectibles.method: Take it next to the Water Pipe blueprint.

collectibles.name: Upper storage note
collectibles.location: Room above the Storage Area
collectibles.method: Flood the area from the Surface Access ladder, then use the broken ladder.

collectibles.name: Plantation door note
collectibles.location: Plantation, next to the first wire-repair door
collectibles.method: Take it beside the door.

collectibles.name: Surface Access note
collectibles.location: Plantation, next to the door marked Surface Access
collectibles.method: Take it beside the door.

collectibles.name: Statue note
collectibles.location: In front of the statue, outside the underground exit
collectibles.method: Take it from the ground there.

collectibles.name: Code panel note
collectibles.location: Tower, Floor 2, next to the code panel
collectibles.method: Take it next to the panel.

collectibles.name: Floor 0 note
collectibles.location: Tower, Floor 0
collectibles.method: Take it as you try to leave the tower.

collectibles.name: Ladder note
collectibles.location: Tower Top, next to the ladder
collectibles.method: Type 4813 into the tower panel so the top detaches, then climb inside and take it.

collectibles.name: Control panel note
collectibles.location: Tower Top, control panel
collectibles.method: Take it from the panel.

achievements.description: Travel 50 meters on a zipline without disjointing.
achievements.summary: Travel 50 meters on a single zipline without letting go.

steps.text: Build a zipline at least 34 foundations long, or use the long zipline at Varuna Point.
Ride it from end to end without disjointing.

achievements.description: Travel 100 meters with the zipline tool.
achievements.summary: Travel a total of 100 meters with the zipline tool.

steps.text: Gather 3 Zipline Parts in Caravan Town, then craft at the worktable on top of the Tower to make the @item{Zipline} and the zipline tool.
Ride ziplines until your total distance reaches 100 meters.

achievements.description: Travel 500 meters with the zipline tool.
achievements.summary: Travel a total of 500 meters with the zipline tool.

steps.text: Ride ziplines until your total distance reaches 500 meters.

achievements.description: Travel 1500 meters with the zipline tool.
achievements.summary: Travel a total of 1500 meters with the zipline tool.

steps.text: Ride ziplines until your total distance reaches 1500 meters.
steps.note: You can ride the same line again and again.

steps.text: Find the @item{Metal Detector} blueprint underwater at @loc{Caravan Town}, by following the pipe from the bike next to the Tower, and craft it.
Find buried treasure with the @item{Metal Detector} and dig it up with a @item{Shovel}.
Dig up one treasure.
Find buried treasure with a @item{Metal Detector} and dig it up with a @item{Shovel}.
Dig up 20 treasures in total.
Find buried treasure with a @item{Metal Detector} and dig it up with a @item{Shovel}.
Dig up 50 treasures in total.

achievements.description: Restore the four pieces of the tiki pole.
achievements.summary: Dig up all 4 tiki pole pieces and stack them in the right order.

guide.context: The pieces are random. Reloading a save does not change which treasures appear.

steps.text: Dig up treasure with a @item{Metal Detector} and Shovel until you have all 4 different tiki pieces.
Stack them from the bottom up: the piece with all teeth, the tongue, the bottom teeth only, then the top teeth only.
They fuse into a tiki and you get a tiki mask.

achievements.summary: Have 30 pipes placed at the same time.

steps.text: Get the Water Pipe blueprint from the room after the sliding puzzle on @loc{Tangaroa}, or the Fuel Pipe blueprint from @loc{Relay Station 4}.
Craft 30 pipes.
Place all 30 pipes on your raft at once.

achievements.summary: Have 10 beehives placed at the same time.

steps.text: Craft 10 @item{Beehives}.
Place all 10 beehives on your raft at once.
Find bee swarms on @loc{Balboa Island}, the Evergreen islands, @loc{Caravan Town} or the desert islands, and catch them with a @item{Sweep Net}.
Capture one bee swarm.
Find bee swarms on @loc{Balboa Island}, the Evergreen islands, @loc{Caravan Town} or the desert islands, and catch them with a @item{Sweep Net}.
Capture 10 bee swarms in total.
Find bee swarms on @loc{Balboa Island}, the Evergreen islands, @loc{Caravan Town} or the desert islands, and catch them with a @item{Sweep Net}.
Capture 25 bee swarms in total.

achievements.description: Reach the secret room behind the Tangaroa containers.
achievements.summary: Reach the secret room beside the container puzzle in Tangaroa's storage area.

steps.text: In the Storage Area, climb the ladder to the Control Room and power the machine with 3 Generator Parts found in the kitchen, behind the bars, and the Storage Area.
Use the crane to move containers and open a path to the secret room south of them, under the crane control room.
Enter the secret room.
steps.note: You can also leave a hole beside it and return after the room floods.

achievements.description: Play a note on an instrument.
achievements.summary: Play a note on an instrument.

steps.text: Collect tokens on @loc{Tangaroa}.
Buy a piano from a vending machine for 8 tokens.
Set the piano down on the raft, then play a single note.
Collect tokens in the buildings of @loc{Tangaroa}.
Spend 10 tokens in total at a vending machine inside the central tower on Tangaroa.
Collect tokens in the buildings of @loc{Tangaroa}.
Spend 20 tokens in total at a vending machine inside the central tower on Tangaroa.

guide.context: Tangaroa holds 33 tokens, and they respawn each time you return to the island.

steps.text: Collect tokens in the buildings of @loc{Tangaroa}.
Spend 30 tokens in total at a vending machine inside the central tower on Tangaroa.
Find Butler-Bots on @loc{Tangaroa}.
Disrupt one @enemy{Butler-Bot}.
Find Butler-Bots on @loc{Tangaroa}.
Disrupt 10 @enemy{Butler-Bots} in total.
Find Butler-Bots on @loc{Tangaroa}.
Disrupt 20 @enemy{Butler-Bots} in total.

achievements.description: Enter the code at the Tangaroa tower.
achievements.summary: Enter the correct code on the panel in the Tangaroa tower to detach the tower top.

steps.text: Climb the ladder to Floor 1 of the Tower, take the elevator, and go to the code panel on Floor 2.
Enter the code 4813.

guide.context: The blueprint island is reached by launching the red rocket on the big island, which needs Explosive Powder.

steps.text: Get the Firework blueprint from the small island in @loc{Caravan Town}.
Kill a Poison-puffer, melt its explosive goo in a smelter to get Explosive Powder, and craft Fireworks. One craft makes 10 and costs Explosive Powder 1, Plank 5 and Plastic 10.
Launch the Fireworks until 50 have exploded.

achievements.summary: Reach floor -20 on Tangaroa using the hidden button in the elevator beside the plantation.

steps.text: Find 9 @item{Tape} in the buildings on the surface. Break @enemy{Butler-Bots} to get a building access card for each one.
Underground, repair the three broken wire boxes with 3 Tape each. Each repair opens the next area.
After the last door, follow the wall signs to the elevator beside the plantation. It leads to Building 6.
Press the hidden button at the top left corner of the elevator doorway.

achievements.description: Learn every crafting recipe found in packages.
achievements.summary: Learn every crafting recipe that comes in small packages.

steps.text: Open floating barrels while sailing and crates on islands to find small packages with a green stamp.
Dig treasure spots found with a Metal Detector; packages can be inside.
Open each package to learn one random recipe you do not know yet. Repeat until none are left to learn.

achievements.description: Defeat the Rhino Shark at Varuna Point.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Rhino Shark boss at Varuna Point.

steps.text: Bring an @item{Oxygen Bottle} and @item{Flippers}. Weapons do nothing to this boss.

Get the @item{Motherlode Key} from the work station at the very end of The Grabber's trap path. Use it on the locked door in the big hole under the building to reach the lower tube. Approach the boss door at its end to start the fight.
On the 1st floor, lure the shark into ramming a pillar until it cracks. Put an @item{Explosive Barrel} inside and let the shark ram it once more to open the way up.
On the 2nd floor, do the same; the pillar takes 2 hits before it breaks.
On the 3rd floor, the pillar takes 3 hits. Destroy it to end the fight.
Find Anglerfish on @loc{Varuna Point} or @loc{Temperance}.
Kill one @enemy{Anglerfish}.
Find Anglerfish on @loc{Varuna Point} or @loc{Temperance}.
Kill 10 @enemy{Anglerfish} in total.
Find Anglerfish on @loc{Varuna Point} or @loc{Temperance}.
Kill 50 @enemy{Anglerfish} in total.

achievements.summary: Finish the story by freeing the people locked up in Utopia.

guide.context: Only the host gets this in multiplayer.

steps.text: Use the coordinates from the note on the laptop in the Temperance cryo-chamber to sail to Utopia.
Defeat @enemy{Olof} in his three fights at the end of Utopia.
Use the master key to open the door to the outside and free the people. The cutscene starts.

achievements.summary: Unlock all four playable characters: Tala, Johnny, Elaine and Shogo.

steps.text: Climb to the highest small room of the @loc{Radio Tower}, where @npc{Tala} sits, and interact with her.
Find @npc{Johnny} inside @loc{Relay Station 6} on Balboa Island and interact with him.
Find @npc{Elaine} inside the detached tower top on Tangaroa, after entering the tower code, and interact with her.
Find @npc{Shogo} at the end of Temperance and interact with the lit screen at the side to free him from his pod.

achievements.description: Purchase an item at a trading post.
achievements.summary: Buy any item at a trading post.

steps.text: Find a large island with a trading post.
Craft a @item{Recycler} (blueprint at the @loc{Radio Tower}) and turn raw materials into Trash Cubes.
Buy any item at the trading post with Trash Cubes, such as @item{Simple Fishing Bait}.

achievements.description: Reach tier 2 in the trading post.
achievements.summary: Reach Tier 2 reputation (300) at a trading post.

steps.text: Buy bait for special fish at a trading post with Trash Cubes and catch special fish.
Sell the fish to the trading post. Each Tier 1 fish gives 10 reputation. Keep selling until you reach 300.

achievements.description: Reach tier 3 in the trading post.
achievements.summary: Reach Tier 3 reputation (3000) at a trading post.

steps.text: At Tier 2, buy the better bait and catch special fish.
Sell them. Each Tier 2 fish gives 100 reputation. Keep selling until you reach 3000.

achievements.description: Have all buffs from meals and drinks active on you at the same time.
achievements.summary: Keep the buffs from every special meal and drink running on your character simultaneously.

steps.text: Buy @item{Chili} and @item{Turmeric} from the trading post found on any large island. Reach Tier 2 there to buy @item{Juniper}.
Cook @item{Catfish Deluxe} in a Cooking Pot: Potato or Beet, Raw Catfish, Cave Mushroom and Chili.
Cook @item{Hearty Stew} in a Cooking Pot: Potato, Cave Mushroom, Raw Meat and Juniper.
Cook @item{Salmon Salad} in a Cooking Pot: Pineapple or Mango, Raw Salmon, Silver Algae and Turmeric.
Make @item{Redbeet Shot} in a Juicer: 2 Beets, Coconut and Turmeric. Make @item{Spicy Pineberry} in a Juicer: Pineapple, 2 Strawberries and Chili.
Eat and drink all five while every earlier buff is still active.

achievements.description: Drive a snowmobile into the sea.
achievements.summary: Drive a snowmobile into the sea on Temperance.

steps.text: Find a storage on Temperance that holds a snowmobile.
Drive the snowmobile into the sea.

achievements.description: Locate all Grabber caches on Varuna Point.
achievements.summary: Look at all 17 red G marks painted on walls in Varuna Point.

guide.context: Look closely at each mark. If the achievement does not unlock, look at the marks again.

collectibles.name: Entry G
collectibles.location: Next to the first note, just inside the jellyfish hole
collectibles.method: Wait for the light to scatter the jellyfish, then enter.

collectibles.name: Air pocket G
collectibles.location: Room on the left with an Anglerfish
collectibles.method: Look at the ceiling where the air is.

collectibles.name: Next floor G
collectibles.location: Floor above the entrance
collectibles.method: Swim up the elevator shaft; the mark is on the wall.

collectibles.name: Hole G
collectibles.location: Large hole under the jellyfish entrance
collectibles.method: Look at the back wall of the hole.

collectibles.name: Tunnel exit G 1
collectibles.location: Just after the tunnel
collectibles.method: First fit 4 Spotlight Parts to the lamp over the tunnel.

collectibles.name: Tunnel exit G 2
collectibles.location: A little farther past the tunnel
collectibles.method: Continue along the path.

collectibles.name: Landing G
collectibles.location: Where you leave the water
collectibles.method: Look beside the note there.

collectibles.name: Bar G
collectibles.location: Next to the bar you climb to the next floor
collectibles.method: Walk slowly and avoid trap ropes.

collectibles.name: Scaffolding G
collectibles.location: Left side while climbing the scaffolding
collectibles.method: Climb to the next floor and look left.

collectibles.name: Trap end G
collectibles.location: End of the traps, before the big room
collectibles.method: Cross the trap corridors.

collectibles.name: Big room G
collectibles.location: Behind the boxes in the big room
collectibles.method: Climb the boxes to leave and look up.

collectibles.name: Exit G
collectibles.location: A little before the end of the path
collectibles.method: Look near the exit door.

collectibles.name: Coral window G
collectibles.location: Hidden room to the left of the coral window
collectibles.method: Follow the coral through the window on the right.

collectibles.name: Big hole G
collectibles.location: Large hole with a door under it
collectibles.method: Look at the wall in the hole; the door needs the Motherlode Key.

collectibles.name: Anglerfish path G
collectibles.location: Path inside the Motherlode Key door
collectibles.method: Look near the Anglerfish.

collectibles.name: Shaft G
collectibles.location: Bottom of the shaft
collectibles.method: Swim down; another Anglerfish is there.

collectibles.name: Boss door G
collectibles.location: Door at the end of the lower tube
collectibles.method: Look at it before the boss fight starts.
